$comment: Edge Function security registry (EDGE-001). Every function must be listed with its exposure class. CI fails when a function on disk or in config.toml is missing here, or when verify_jwt drifts from this record. Exposure classes: public-auth | human-authenticated | portal-authenticated | internal-service | webhook | cron-worker | public | needs-review.

aml-idv-retention.notes: Daily capture-retention sweep. Signed internal callers only (verifySignedInternal: pg_cron, aml-verification, aml-records); gateway JWT applies on top (not declared in config.toml, so verify_jwt defaults true). Deletes identity captures only when both retention clocks agree (aml.retention_triggers minimum_retention_date AND AML_IDV_CAPTURE_RETENTION_DAYS) and no legal hold exists; deletion scope is limited to DELETABLE_BUCKETS.

aml-verification-processor.notes: Didit Standalone verification driver (targeted mode + 1-minute cron sweep). Signed internal callers only (verifySignedInternal: pg_cron, aml-client-portal, aml-verification); gateway JWT applies on top (not declared in config.toml, so verify_jwt defaults true). Holds the provider credential and spends money; outcome authority stays in verificationOutcome.pure.ts and paid calls are never blindly retried.

authenticated-data.notes: ES256 remediation: cookie-authenticated data gateway. Holds service-role but exposes only an explicit table allow-list, each entry carrying the authority rule its RLS policy already expresses (module permission, owner column, or user_roles membership). Identity comes solely from the session cookie; CSRF and exact-origin CORS enforced. Not a generic proxy.

builder-stock-image-settler.notes: Cron sweep that brings already-imported builder stock up to the current image rules. Signed internal callers only (verifyInternal) with enforceRawBodyLimit ahead of it; holds a service-role client and crosses organisations, so it must not be reachable by a portal session. Writes builder_stock_item_images, the primary_image_id those rows earn, and the settlement marker; creates and deletes no stock item and touches no price, availability, status, selection or project linkage. Resumable and bounded per tick, and the migration's cron job unschedules itself once no upload is below the current version.

builder-stock-link-callback.notes: Google Sheets hyperlink recovery callback. Authenticated by a per-request one-time capability token presented as `Authorization: Bearer`: each request mints 256 bits of randomness, sends it to Make and stores only its SHA-256, so there is no long-lived shared secret in two systems and a token seen in a third party's log authorises one answer to one question already asked. The token is compared by constant-time hash equality, the request is single-use via an atomic claim, expires in 30 minutes, and is bound to the exact spreadsheet and tab. Body is capped and the organisation is rate limited. Carries no Supabase identity because the caller is an external automation. Organisation, upload and property authority are read from the stored request row and are never accepted from the payload.

didit-webhook.notes: Didit hosted IDV callback. HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body (X-Signature) plus a 300s X-Timestamp window is the auth boundary; verified before any service-role access. Never trusts the body's decision - the authoritative result is re-read server-side.

dispatch-workflow-triggers.notes: Drains workflow_trigger_events and runs the live workflows a captured event starts. Accepts only HMAC-signed pg_cron calls (verifySignedInternal, caller allow-list ["pg_cron"]); holds service-role to claim events and record runs. Step execution goes through _shared/workflow/stepExecutor.ts, whose allow-list is the same one execute-workflow-step enforces.

report-api-usage.notes: Drains api_usage_log into Mission Control per-tenant API-key metering. Auth: INTERNAL_EDGE_SECRET or cron secret, constant-time compared. Reads a billing queue - never public.
